title: Cochran-Armitage test for trend in a proportion
summary: Whether a binary outcome's proportion changes steadily across ordered groups, with the slope per score step.

sizing._why: The catalog has no trend-test form; sizing one needs the full pattern of proportions across groups and is a simulation.

pinned_defaults: R: prop.trend.test(score = the dose values). The default score is 1, 2, ..., k.
Python: the statistic is written out and divides by N (Cochran-Armitage, as R reports). The linear-by-linear association test divides by N - 1 and is a different number.
_scores_matter: The test is only as meaningful as the scores. With unequally spaced doses, equally spaced default scores test a different trend.
